new_material_findings.finding: Current PR gate lineage v1-v3 relies on model_input_in_rendered_prompt/supervision_in_target declarations for visibility; v2/v3 materially strengthen state semantics and causal derivation but still do not byte-compare canonical model_input against actual prompt or parsed supervision against actual target.
new_material_findings.consequence: Use gate v4 as the byte-grounded successor layer over v3; v3 remains the causal derivation/state validator.

new_material_findings.finding: Current reference-labeler v1 stores one decision_role on the shared evidence object while branch_relations independently map that evidence to SUPPORT/COUNTER/FALSIFY/NO_EFFECT per branch. A single decisive discriminator can support one branch and contradict/falsify another, so its decision role is branch-relative. One global DECISIVE_SUPPORT/DECISIVE_CONTRADICTION field cannot faithfully encode both roles simultaneously.
new_material_findings.consequence: Successor schema should derive/store decision role per (evidence_event, branch), or derive decisive support/contradiction directly from branch relation + discriminator receipt rather than a global caller field.

new_material_findings.finding: Current main audit reduces the old D/E blocker from missing labelers to an unbound causal derivation chain: task-world semantics must mechanically derive branch relations/decision roles, discriminator execution/admissibility and separation before training admission.
new_material_findings.consequence: No D/E positive-volume expansion or training promotion before derivation receipts and admission integration.
